provenance.route: Primary Codex assistant in the author's revision continuation
provenance.generation_context: The project revision guidance, incoming fixed-Cp tangent, plastic stress partials, threshold expansion, complete exponential material return, and four already observed locally repaired intervals.
provenance.selection: The coupled relation and regional span were implemented before their numerical evaluation in this task. The deployable frozen-basis form was then constructed to remove global operator assembly from repeated queries.
provenance.evidence_role: Construction and diagnosis; all four PINN intervals were already observed. No prospective validation is claimed.

name: Regional loading modes with finite-return plastic feedback

expressions.coupled_increment: K_n,h d + B_n [Cp_return(F_n + grad d; Cp_n,kappa_n)-Cp_n] = h f_n
expressions.hinge_option: delta_Cp = Q_n relu(dPhi_n : grad d - margin_n) / D_n
expressions.basis: V = orth([v_load, v_region for each region with nonzero plastic forcing])
expressions.reduced_step: (V^T K_n,h V) b + V^T B_n delta_Cp(V b) = h V^T f_n
expressions.outputs: C_next from exact predicted chord lengths; z_next from fixed reference tensor kernels

mechanical_coefficients: K_el and B are fixed-Cp and fixed-F stress partials at the known reference state. Follower pressure coefficients retain the requested pressure and current wall deformation. No endpoint regression coefficients are fitted.
state_choice: Retain material-point Cp and kappa, so spatial margins and directions remain available; reduce displacement to three amplitudes. The eight tensor moments remain outputs, not a sufficient Markov state.
residual_policy: Preserve the incoming weak residual in the main increment relation. Compute the linear response to -R_n separately as a sensitivity. Never use a target endpoint residual as a predictor input.
deployment: reduced_model.npz freezes the three modes, stress partials and incoming field at pressure ratio 0.7000, with regional forcing constructed for h=0.0125. The online implementation reads only this artifact and its own advanced state.
evaluated_domain: Current e=40,s=0.20 monotone unloading path. Four one-step diagnostics; direct and two-half-step predictions from the common 0.7000 state. Original pressure formulas and frozen affine closure remain unchanged.
